name: Bathhouse Williamsburg
priceLabel: Day pass from $39, the price moves with the day and time · no time limit · Core membership, $99 a year, gets the member price on every pass
sauna: A dry sauna at 175–190°F, a banya at 185–195°F and an event sauna for guided sessions at up to 175°F, with a steam room at 115°F and heated marble hammams
pool: Cold plunges at 45°F and 50°F, hot pools at 104°F, neutral pools at 98°F and a rooftop pool at 84°F, weather permitting
hours: Daily 08:00–23:30 · stay as long as you like, no re-entry
bestFor: Saunas, thermal pools and a rooftop pool
flag: 18 and over. Bathing suits are required everywhere but the locker rooms; towels and slippers are provided. Book ahead: walk-ins only when there is room, and weekends usually sell out. Phones stay in the locker.
aufgussNote: Sauna Masters host a 15-minute Aufguss with essential oils, music and towel waving every day at 12:00, 13:30, 15:00, 16:30, 18:00, 19:30 and 21:00. It is announced in the house, costs nothing extra and needs no booking

name: Russian & Turkish Baths
priceLabel: $60 single admission · 5 admissions $250 · 10 for $475, valid for two people · prices do not include sales tax and card fees
sauna: Five saunas and steam rooms, among them the Russian Room, a Redwood Sauna, a Turkish Room and an Aromatherapy Room; platza with oak leaves in the Russian Room
pool: An ice-cold plunge pool, and a roof deck
hours: Mon–Wed, Fri 12:00–22:00 · Thu 12:00–22:00, men only until 17:00 · Sat 10:00–22:00 · Sun 09:00–22:00, men only until 14:00 · open 365 days a year
flag: Walk-ins only: they take no reservations for the baths, massages or treatments. 18 and over. You must be covered during co-ed hours; robes, towels, shorts and slippers are provided. Two owners run alternate shifts, and a multi-visit pass or gift card is good only on the shift of the owner who sold it.

name: Othership Flatiron
priceLabel: Sessions booked online · the drop-in price is shown only in their booking widget
sauna: A performance sauna of Western Red Cedar heated up to 185°F, with aromatic snowballs for humidity; 75-minute guided classes or self-guided free flow sessions
pool: Eight ice baths kept at 32–40°F, some for four people
hours: Session times on their site · booked online, up to two weeks ahead
flag: 18 and over. Bathing suits are required and it is barefoot beyond the changing rooms; two towels are provided. Arrive 10 to 15 minutes early: there is no late entry once the sauna doors close. No phones past the entrance, and no alcohol.

name: QC NY
priceLabel: Sunset session, from 17:00, from $124 · Escape, 5 hours, from $138 · Daily, no time limit, from $170 · robe, towels and slippers included
sauna: Seven saunas, among them the City, Fall, Mountain and Refuge saunas, with two steam baths, an infrared room, Vichy showers and relaxation rooms
pool: Two heated outdoor pools facing the Manhattan skyline, and a music pool
hours: Sun–Thu 09:00–22:00 · Fri–Sat 09:00–23:00 · entry by reserved time slot · hours change on holidays
bestFor: Saunas and outdoor pools facing the skyline
flag: 21 and over, with a valid ID. It is on Governors Island: ferries leave from the Battery Maritime Building, 10 South Street. Bring a bathing suit. They recommend arriving at least two hours before closing, and there is no re-entry.
